title: Handover scenario tests
description: scenarios.json in a frozen handover (handovers/<id>/), present only when the handover holds a bound structured test scenario (compiled to a test) or lists one it did not compile (`skipped`). Written by Core.handoverPlan at freeze and named in handover.yaml as `scenario_tests:`. The generated tests are verbatim copies at ui-contract/tests/<screen>.scenarios.page.test.tsx, inside the handover id; scenarios.json itself is derived. Each test is Vitest browser mode, in the same `ui-page` project as the page test (describe title "<screen> scenarios", so a page-test report that keeps only "<screen> page" does not count it). Test titles are "<scenario id> example <n>" (n is `examples[].index`). The test fails with the message "<scenario id> example <n>: <METHOD> <path> body" when the request body differs. The scenario files themselves (test-scenarios/*.yaml) are named by path and sha256 but not copied. designc owns this contract; consumers conform to it. docs/handover-scenarios.example.json is the shared fixture.

screens.description: One entry per render screen with at least one compiled scenario, ordered by screen. A scenario of an overlay (hosted) spec is on the host's entry.

component.description: The page component the test imports and renders (the spec's `component`).

path.description: Registry path of the scenario file.

operation.description: The request the test waits for, resolved from contracts/openapi at freeze; path is the OpenAPI path as written. The test mocks it with `{p}` as `:p`, after the path part of the file's servers[0].url if it has one.

index.description: 1-based; the n in the test title.

skipped.description: Structured scenarios of a requirement in the handover that were not compiled, with the reason. Never dropped silently. Ordered by scenario id.
